quick_skim.title: C3M: Cross-Session Multimodal Memory Maintenance for Long-Horizon Tasks
quick_skim.abstract: Long-horizon tasks require preserving and later recovering cross-session evidence under a bounded, query-blind memory budget. Existing compression can discard fine-grained visual cues or conflate semantically similar but incompatible observations. We present C3M, a cross-session multimodal memory organization that maintains a bounded active index over persistent source text-image evidence. Relation-aware updates consolidate safe redundancy while preserving complementary and incompatible records. At query time, budgeted routing selects useful index pages and expands their associated source evidence under a fixed reader budget. Together, these mechanisms establish a compact, provenance-preserving multimodal memory organization for cross-session long-horizon tasks, retaining temporal distinctions and source links required for reliable downstream reasoning. Code is available at https://github.com/HuzhouNLP/C3M.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: C3M addresses cross-session long-horizon tasks where compression discards fine visual cues or conflates incompatible observations, maintaining a bounded active index over persistent text-image evidence with relation-aware updates and budgeted query-time routing for retrieval.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 论文针对长时程任务中跨会话证据保存与恢复的难题，指出既有压缩方法会丢失细粒度视觉线索或混淆语义相近但不兼容的观测。C3M维护一个覆盖持久文本-图像证据的有界活跃索引，通过关系感知更新合并安全冗余、保留互补与冲突记录，并在查询时用预算化路由选择索引页并展开源证据。该机制在固定读取预算下实现了紧凑且保留来源的多模态记忆组织，为跨会话长时程任务提供支撑。
